statement: A company must give notice to any person it knows or has cause to believe is a registrable person or registrable relevant legal entity (a person with significant control) whose status or required particulars the company has not had confirmed; the notice must require the person to confirm the status and, where it applies, to give the company all of the required particulars.
caveat: The Economic Crime and Corporate Transparency Act 2023 omitted the company's own PSC register duty (section 790M) with effect from 18 November 2025; PSC information flows to the central register at Companies House. Confirm the current Part 21A duties and Companies House notification requirements before relying.
